Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock - Kiwi
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[size=4][b]Increase your animal diversity by adding kiwi to your farm![/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Another smaller mod this time around for all those bird enthusiasts ~ 

Features[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adds kiwi to your farm as a coop animal[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Produces eggs and high friendship unlocks the chance to drop feathers[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Kiwi eggs -> Mayonnaise [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No unlocking required, added to Marnie's shop immediately. One unlockable skin[/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]When you reach 5 hearts with the Wizard he will send you a letter the next day. The Junimiwi will be unlocked in Marnie's shop/as a skin upon reading the letter.[/color][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]** You must have Extra Animal Configs installed in order for kiwi to fit through the coop door. Sprites are on a 32x32 sheet for better detail, without EAC your kiwi cannot leave the coop and may cause additional bugs. [/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires both SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Extra Animal Config to function. I also recommend Livestock Bazaar to find this animal in Marnie's shop smoothly. [/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install the latest SMAPI, Extra Animal Config, and Content Patcher mod updates.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip BBs Kiwi, then move it to your Mods folder. [/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to the New Zealand Government's [url=https://www.doc.govt.nz/nature/native-animals/birds/bird-songs-and-calls/]Department of Conservation[/url] for providing royalty-free calls of endemic birds (with acknowledgement), edited in this mod for kiwi sound. [/color][/size]
